feature_name: Predefined MySQL function library for Spanner
summary: Spanner offers a predefined library of over 80 MySQL-compatible user-defined functions that can be installed into a database to reduce migration changes from MySQL.

evidence_snippets: Disaster recovery techniques Spanner offers disaster recovery techniques to protect your data against the following disasters: Zonal failure : Spanner regional configuration provides automatic protection against zonal failures, ensuring that if one zone within a region fails, your application remains operational.
